% Written by `lab paper game-rating`; do not edit by hand.
\begin{tabularx}{\textwidth}{lL}
\toprule
Number & What it is \\
\midrule
\texttt{ply} & How many half-moves into the game the position is. \\
\texttt{log\_clock} & The seconds left on the mover's clock, as log(1 + seconds). \\
\texttt{log\_opponent\_clock} & The seconds left on the opponent's clock, as log(1 + seconds). \\
\texttt{log\_spent} & The seconds the move took, as log(1 + seconds). \\
\texttt{win\_before} & The mover's win probability from the engine's evaluation of the position, in percent. \\
\texttt{loss} & The mover's win probability before the move less the one after it, in points of a percent. \\
\texttt{legal\_moves} & How many legal moves the mover has. \\
\texttt{capture} & Whether the move played took something. \\
\texttt{check} & Whether the move played gave check. \\
\texttt{castle\_own\_king} & Whether the mover may still castle on the king's side. \\
\texttt{castle\_own\_queen} & Whether the mover may still castle on the queen's side. \\
\texttt{castle\_opp\_king} & Whether the opponent may still castle on the king's side. \\
\texttt{castle\_opp\_queen} & Whether the opponent may still castle on the queen's side. \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabularx}
